claims.claim: You have the biller role, or admin.
claims.finding: Cannot be confirmed from code as a role rule. The Billing page (and its Denials tab) is gated by the feature "Billing Operations" (frontend/src/user-routes.tsx:956-962), not by a named biller/admin role. Appeal-status saves are a direct browser write to denial_management (frontend/src/utils/hooks/useBillingDashboard.ts:986-995); who may write is decided by database policy, which the migrations at v1.1.345 do not show (only a SELECT policy, backend/supabase/migrations/20260511270000_rls_billing_tranche3a.sql:97).
claims.proposed_text: You can open Billing (your account needs the Billing Operations feature).

claims.claim: Every denial record carries an appeal status. These are the values Medipyxis tracks: Not Started, Needs Review, In Research, Pending Documentation, Pending Provider Input, Ready to Appeal, Appeal Submitted, Under Payer Review, Additional Info Requested, Appeal Accepted, Appeal Denied.
Claim Corrected & Resubmitted — The claim was corrected and resubmitted rather than formally appealed.
claims.finding: The option label is "Claim Corrected and Resubmitted" (frontend/src/pages/BillingDashboard.tsx:739).
claims.proposed_text: Claim Corrected and Resubmitted — The claim was corrected and resubmitted rather than formally appealed.

claims.claim: Closed — No Further Action: Denial closed; nothing further to do. Closed — Written Off: Denial closed and the balance written off.
claims.finding: The labels use an en dash, not an em dash: "Closed – No Further Action" and "Closed – Written Off" (frontend/src/pages/BillingDashboard.tsx:740-741). Selecting one only writes the status; nothing writes off a balance (updateAppealStatus, frontend/src/utils/hooks/useBillingDashboard.ts:986-995).
claims.proposed_text: Closed – No Further Action: Denial closed; nothing further to do. Closed – Written Off: Denial marked as written off (this status does not post a write-off to the ledger).

proposed_checks.note: the appeal-status writer never touches the ledger

claims.claim: Not Appealed — A decision was made not to appeal this denial. Appeal Approved — The appeal was approved — the claim should proceed to payment.
claims.finding: Both are listed as legacy values: "Not Appealed (legacy)" and "Appeal Approved (legacy)" (frontend/src/pages/BillingDashboard.tsx:742-744).
claims.proposed_text: Not Appealed (legacy) and Appeal Approved (legacy) are older values still shown in the list; use Appeal Accepted or a Closed status for new work.

claims.claim: Open the Denials view. From the Billing module, open Denials.
The Appeal Status column shows the current stage for each denial.

checks.note: shows the raw stored value with only the first underscore replaced, not the dropdown label

claims.claim: Sort by aging to surface the oldest denials first, and filter by Appeal Status to find items that have not been actioned.

checks.note: a sort control for the denials list

claims.finding: There is no sort control on the Denials list. Denials load newest first (.order('created_at', { ascending: false }), frontend/src/utils/hooks/useBillingDashboard.ts:945); the only control is the Appeal status filter (frontend/src/pages/BillingDashboard.tsx:4753-4770).
claims.proposed_text: The list shows the newest denial first. Use the Appeal status filter to find items that have not been actioned.

claims.claim: Click a denied claim to open the denial detail. Review: the denial reason code and description from the ERA or payer correspondence; the original claim's date of service, procedure codes, and diagnosis codes; any previous appeal history in the activity log.

checks.note: the detail would show reason, DOS or codes

claims.finding: The detail opens from the eye button (title "View / update denial"), not by clicking the claim. The "Denial / Appeal Workflow" panel shows only the claim number, patient, an Appeal status dropdown and a Notes history (frontend/src/pages/BillingDashboard.tsx:5333-5425). It shows no date of service, procedure or diagnosis codes; the denial reason is only in the list's Denial Reason column (line 4822-4825). There is no activity log of status changes.
claims.proposed_text: Click the eye icon (View / update denial) to open the Denial / Appeal Workflow panel. It shows the claim number, the appeal status and a timestamped notes history. The denial reason is in the list's Denial Reason column.

claims.claim: Set status to Needs Review. This signals to other billers that the denial is being worked.

Common denial categories and typical responses: missing or invalid documentation; medical necessity; duplicate claim; timely filing (gather clearinghouse timestamps); coding error; authorization missing.
claims.finding: Billing guidance, not product behavior. No code maps a category to a response.

claims.claim: Gather supporting documentation. Attach the payer's denial EOB/ERA detail, clinical notes supporting medical necessity, and any payer-specific appeal form.

checks.note: an attachment control on the denial

claims.finding: A denial record has no attachment control: the Denial / Appeal Workflow panel has only the appeal status and text notes (frontend/src/components/denials/DenialNotesPanel.tsx has no upload; frontend/src/pages/BillingDashboard.tsx:5356-5425).
claims.proposed_text: Gather supporting documentation: the payer's denial EOB/ERA detail, clinical notes supporting medical necessity, and any payer-specific appeal form. Denial records hold text notes only, so keep the files with your appeal package and note where they are.

claims.claim: Write the appeal narrative in the notes.
Set status to Appeal Submitted and record the submission date.

checks.note: a field for the submission date

claims.finding: There is no submission-date field. Saving a status writes appeal_status, appeal_notes and updated_at only (frontend/src/utils/hooks/useBillingDashboard.ts:989-993).
claims.proposed_text: Set status to Appeal Submitted (or use the Mark appeal submitted button on the row) and write the submission date in the notes.

claims.claim: Medicare first-level redeterminations must be filed within 120 days of the initial denial; second-level reconsiderations within 180 days.
claims.finding: Medicare regulatory fact (42 CFR 405.942 / 405.962), not encoded in the product. Cannot be checked against code.

claims.claim: Medipyxis does not currently auto-calculate appeal deadlines.

checks.note: no code computes appeal_deadline; the only assignments copy a stored value or are type declarations

claims.claim: Approved → set Appeal Approved. The claim should reprocess for payment and post through an ERA.

checks.pattern: const ledger = eraId ? await postEraToLedger(supabase, eraId) : null;

claims.finding: Appeal Approved is a legacy option, labelled "Appeal Approved (legacy)" (frontend/src/pages/BillingDashboard.tsx:744). ERA posting does happen automatically (backend/supabase/functions/_shared/stediEraImport.ts:486).
claims.proposed_text: Approved → set Appeal Accepted. The payment posts to the claim's ledger when the payer's ERA arrives.

proposed_checks.pattern: const ledger = eraId ? await postEraToLedger(supabase, eraId) : null;

claims.claim: Accepted for review → Appeal Accepted. Denied → Appeal Denied. Corrected instead of appealed → Claim Corrected & Resubmitted.
claims.finding: The third label is "Claim Corrected and Resubmitted" (frontend/src/pages/BillingDashboard.tsx:739).
claims.proposed_text: Accepted for review → Appeal Accepted. Denied → Appeal Denied. Corrected instead of appealed → Claim Corrected and Resubmitted.

claims.claim: The denial record reflects the current appeal status and a full activity trail.

checks.note: a status change would be logged to the notes trail

claims.finding: Status changes are not recorded anywhere: updateAppealStatus overwrites appeal_status and appeal_notes in place (frontend/src/utils/hooks/useBillingDashboard.ts:986-995). The only history is the notes billers type (DenialNotesPanel).
claims.proposed_text: The denial record shows its current appeal status and the notes billers have added. Earlier statuses are not kept, so note each change.

claims.claim: Closed denials drop out of the active Denials view; use the status filter to include them in reporting.

checks.note: closed statuses would be excluded from the default view

claims.finding: Nothing hides closed denials. With the filter on All the list shows every denial (frontend/src/pages/BillingDashboard.tsx:749-752).
claims.proposed_text: Closed denials stay in the list. Filter by a Closed status to find them, or by another status to hide them.

claims.claim: Do not set a denial to Closed — Written Off without supervisor approval. Write-offs affect your facility's net collection rate and are reviewed in reporting.
claims.finding: Practice policy, not product behavior. The product has no approval step: any user who can save the dropdown can pick Closed – Written Off (frontend/src/pages/BillingDashboard.tsx:5388-5399).

claims.claim: Review the Claims Reports in the Reports Center periodically to spot systemic issues.
Denial not visible in the Denials view — ERA has not been posted yet — Check the ERA/Payments view; post the ERA first.

checks.note: something would create a denial record
ERA posting would create denial records

claims.finding: Posting an ERA never creates a denial record. Nothing at v1.1.345 inserts into denial_management: createDenial is defined (frontend/src/utils/hooks/useBillingDashboard.ts:959) but never called, and the ERA import/posting code does not touch the table.
claims.proposed_text: Denial not in the Denials view — Medipyxis does not create denial records from ERAs. A denied or $0 ERA line shows on the ERA / EOB page as "Denied / $0, nothing to post".

claims.claim: Appeal Status dropdown is read-only — Your role does not have edit access — Ask your administrator to verify your role permissions.

checks.note: a role-based read-only state on the dropdown

claims.finding: The dropdown is never read-only (frontend/src/pages/BillingDashboard.tsx:5370-5377). If the account cannot write, the Save shows the error toast from updateAppealStatus (frontend/src/utils/hooks/useBillingDashboard.ts:1003-1006).
claims.proposed_text: Saving the appeal status shows an error — your account may not be allowed to update denial records — Ask your administrator to verify your role permissions.

claims.claim: Denial shows Appeal Approved but no ERA payment received — Payer reprocessing is pending — Wait for the next ERA cycle; check the Stedi dashboard for a pending 835.
claims.finding: Payer-side and Stedi-portal advice; not product behavior. Appeal Approved is a legacy status (frontend/src/pages/BillingDashboard.tsx:744).
